test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct indirect narration of the following statement from the given alternatives:

The farmers said, "It is time to plough our fields as the soil has become damp."

options.text: The farmers said that it has been time to plough their fields as the soil had become damp.
The farmers said that it was time to plough their fields as the soil had become damp.
The farmers said that it had been time to plough their fields as the soil had become damp.
The farmers said that it was time to plough their fields as the soil has been damp.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The farmers said that it was time to plough their fields as the soil had become damp.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"It is time" becomes "it was time":**
 
 
• In indirect speech, present tense ("is") changes to past tense ("was").
